A tiny natural breeze stirs only the leaves. Preserve readable real signage without changing letter shapes. Keep the interior warm and inviting with bright detailed windows and nuanced shadows. No people, no cars appearing, no time lapse, no large dramatic push, no lens flare, no moving doorway, no architectural change, no cut. A purposeful expensive-feeling commercial opening, photographed with human restraint.
